-- (2026-10-22 UI polish) bigger Gift / Settings / Rebirth / Index (M5: every label >= 16 px at the 1050 x 620 base) and a
	-- wider Shop (M3: its side tabs moved INSIDE the window). Was Shop {2.0, 1.6} (the window is height-dominant + fit-within: a wider aspect alone makes it shorter), Index {2.0, 1.75}, Gift {1.95, 1.2},
	-- Rebirth {1.55, 1.25}, Settings {1.55, 1.3}.
	local LAYOUT = {Shop = {2.28, 1.82, 0.11}, Index = {2.3, 1.85}, Gift = {2.25, 1.32}, Rebirth = {2.0, 1.45}, Sell = {1.5, 1.05}, Settings = {2.05, 1.3}}

edits.old_string:
local TITLES = {Gift = "Playtime Rewards", Index = "Creature Index"}
	panel.Title.Text = TITLES[name] or name
edits.new_string:
local TITLES = {Gift = "Playtime Rewards", Index = "Creature Index"}
	panel.Title.Text = TITLES[name] or name
	-- (2026-10-22 UI polish, M4) the white Settings header: its title gets a solid 3 px black outline (the shared title's
	-- ScaledSize stroke is about 2.3 px there); every other page gets the shared stroke back
	local ts = panel.Title:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if ts then
		if ts:GetAttribute("PolishBase") == nil then
			ts:SetAttribute("PolishBase", ts.Thickness)
			ts:SetAttribute("PolishMode", ts.StrokeSizingMode.Name)
			ts:SetAttribute("PolishColor", ts.Color)
		end
		if name == "Settings" then
			ts.StrokeSizingMode = Enum.StrokeSizingMode.FixedSize
			ts.Thickness = 3 * math.max(B.viewportSize().Y / 620, 0.7)
			ts.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		else
			ts.StrokeSizingMode = Enum.StrokeSizingMode[ts:GetAttribute("PolishMode")]
			ts.Thickness = ts:GetAttribute("PolishBase")
			ts.Color = ts:GetAttribute("PolishColor")
		end
	end

edits.new_string:
local size = lay and mul(winSize, lay[1]) or winSize
	-- (2026-10-22 UI polish, M5) phones: a window keeps >= 0.7 of its 620 px-tall size (a Scale window would get 390 / 620 =
	-- 0.63 on a 390 px phone); fitScale below still keeps it on the screen
	size = mul(size, math.max(1, 434 / math.max(B.viewportSize().Y, 1)))
	size = mul(size, fitScale(size))
